title: Existing form submission
objective: Submit a form issued on v1 after cutover to v2; preserve valid prior submissions under compatible anti-forgery configuration while rejecting forged or unpaired requests.
trainingLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
infrastructure: N/A: resource-free offline browser lesson; no IaC or resource operations.
preconditions: v1 rendered one old form with synthetic request/cookie pair A, fixture key OLD and application A
v2 always checks old-key readability, application boundary, request integrity and cookie binding
No real identity, token, cookie, secret, registration or cryptographic implementation
actions: Choose compatible, retired-old-key or changed-application configuration
Choose valid prior, forged, missing-cookie or foreign-pair condition
Load the form on v1, cut over to v2, submit exactly once
Inspect separate assertion, submission, continuity, check and effect measurements
Reset current with defaults and focus restored; retain completed history

compatibleValid: v2 retains key OLD and application A
ACCEPTED / SUCCESS / continuity preserved / one synthetic effect
compatibleForged: REJECTED / safety SUCCESS / continuity not tested / zero effects
incompatibleValid: v2 lacks old key or changes application boundary
REJECTED / FAILURE / continuity interrupted / zero effects
missingObservation: UNKNOWN / no invented status, acceptance, rejection or effects

expectedAssertions: Compatible validation accepts a valid prior request/cookie pair exactly once
Forged, missing-cookie and foreign-pair submissions remain rejected
Retired old keys and changed application boundaries interrupt valid old forms without disabling checks
Missing observations remain unknown, not zero effects or successful continuity
Malformed inputs, skipped phases, repeated submissions, forged histories and exhausted bounds reject without mutation
Completed failure/success/unknown traces remain immutable across keyboard reset
Actual file-browser CSP blocks inline code/handlers/styles, connections, form navigation, base changes and workers
limits: One form, one cutover and one submission per rehearsal
Six completed histories with no eviction; reset retains them and reload clears page memory
Reset before submission discards only unsubmitted setup
Synthetic fixture checks are not real authentication, anti-forgery security or exactly-once effect certification
No native Azure, Node24 production, source-parent or reliability proof

testTooling.lifecycle: Each isolated session is closed in an awaited finally. Known helper lifecycle limits remain; no abandoned prototype.

acceptance: Parent-owned empirical acceptance pending; no worker-awarded Done credit.
